A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same GBPN research and contain complete main text and Appendix A.1–A.9. Textual and rendered-page comparisons support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, figures and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original GBPN benchmark results, ablations, robustness tests and generalization experiments in Section 4, with additional empirical analyses in Appendix A.

after.justification: v3 retains original GBPN benchmark, ablation and generalization results, together with appendix experiments on sparsity, noise, confidence estimation and efficiency.

M1.justification: Both versions use the same dynamic MRF construction, GBPN-1/GBPN-2 architectures, serial/parallel GBP inference and probability-based loss. Section 3, Algorithm 1 and Appendix A.2 describe unchanged procedures.

E1.justification: NYUv2, KITTI and VOID coverage is unchanged. Both versions retain the same varying-sparsity, reduced-LiDAR-scan, noisy-input and zero-shot generalization scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within the corresponding benchmark, robustness and efficiency comparisons. Table 1 retains DMD3C, BP-Net, OGNI-DC, CFormer and the other existing baselines; appendix comparisons also match.

E3.justification: Data splits, preprocessing, metrics and training budgets are unchanged. Both retain NYUv2 training with 500 sampled depth points and zero-shot VOID evaluation at 150, 500 and 1500 points.

E4.justification: The V1–V9 ablations, propagation and confidence analyses, sparsity/noise tests, and efficiency/iteration studies are unchanged. The corrected figure reference introduces no new analysis.

E5.justification: Seed information and statistical reporting practices are unchanged. Appendix A.6 specifies the same 100 random sparse-input samplings per test image and averaging over those samples.

E6.justification: Corresponding numerical and qualitative results match throughout. For example, Table 1 reports GBPN KITTI RMSE of 681.61 mm and NYUv2 RMSE of 0.085 m in both versions; appendix result tables and images are also unchanged.

T1.justification: The MRF formulation, Gaussian assumptions, GBP update equations and Appendix A.1 derivation are unchanged. Restyling appendix references does not alter mathematical content.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction and conclusion retain the same contributions and claims concerning learned MRF construction, adaptive non-local edges, hybrid propagation, accuracy, robustness and generalization.

C2.justification: The robustness explanations and limitations remain unchanged, including empirically chosen hyperparameters, limited training data and the efficiency limitations of the custom GBP implementation.

D1.justification: Architecture, preprocessing, optimizer, hardware and training details in Appendix A.2–A.3 are unchanged. The code and trained-model availability statement is also retained without revision.

R1.justification: Section 2, all 56 references, and the positioning relative to traditional graphical models and learned depth-completion methods are unchanged.

P1.justification: Main-text references to Appendix A.1–A.8 are restyled from 'Appendix' to 'Sec.', and the arXiv version/date stamp changes. There is no substantive rewriting or section reordering.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption corrects its appendix reference from Figure 8 to Figure 12. Limited text reflow shifts Algorithm 1 and Tables 1–2 vertically; figure artwork, table structures and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: Figure 1 now correctly directs readers to the sparsity comparisons in Figure 12 instead of the non-local-edge visualization in Figure 8. This provides a small improvement in locating supporting evidence; the scientific content, empirical support and reproducibility information remain unchanged.
